answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. A mirror of per-task receipts records who did what, and the basalt of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the meadow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
